module_summary: PicoRV32 SoC: the CPU's native memory bus is address-decoded to on-chip RAM, an SPI flash XIP controller, UART registers and an external iomem port, with a priority read-data mux and OR-ed ready.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: CPU bus request valid qualifying every address-decoded peripheral select.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Bus ready OR-ed from RAM, flash, UART, cfg and iomem responders.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: CPU bus address decoded into RAM, flash, UART, cfgreg and iomem regions.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Priority read-data mux selecting iomem, flash, RAM or register data to CPU.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: CPU write data broadcast to RAM, UART and flash config registers.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes gated per selected slave into write enables.

anchors.name: iomem_valid
anchors.why: External iomem request for addresses above 0x01FFFFFF.

anchors.name: iomem_ready
anchors.why: External iomem completion feeding mem_ready and read mux select.

anchors.name: iomem_addr
anchors.why: External bus address copied from CPU mem_addr.

anchors.name: iomem_rdata
anchors.why: External read data selected into mem_rdata.

anchors.name: iomem_wdata
anchors.why: External write data copied from CPU mem_wdata.

anchors.name: spimemio_cfgreg_sel
anchors.why: Decodes 0x02000000 to select SPI flash config register access.

anchors.name: simpleuart_reg_div_sel
anchors.why: Decodes 0x02000004 to select UART baud divider register.

anchors.name: simpleuart_reg_dat_sel
anchors.why: Decodes 0x02000008 to select UART data register read/write.

anchors.name: ram_ready
anchors.why: Registered one-cycle RAM response for addresses below RAM size.

anchors.name: spimem_ready
anchors.why: SPI flash read completion selecting spimem_rdata.

anchors.name: simpleuart_reg_dat_wait
anchors.why: UART stall flag holding off mem_ready during data register access.

anchors.name: irq
anchors.why: 32-bit interrupt request vector assembled from irq_5..7 to the CPU.

anchors.name: ser_tx
anchors.why: UART serial transmit line from simpleuart.

anchors.name: ser_rx
anchors.why: UART serial receive line into simpleuart.

anchors.name: flash_csb
anchors.why: SPI flash chip select driven by spimemio.

anchors.name: flash_clk
anchors.why: SPI flash serial clock generated by spimemio.

anchors.name: flash_io0_do
anchors.why: Representative flash IO output data bit (quad IO0..3).

anchors.name: flash_io0_di
anchors.why: Representative flash IO input data bit (quad IO0..3).

anchors.name: spimem_rdata
anchors.why: Flash read word from spimemio into read mux.

anchors.name: ram_rdata
anchors.why: RAM read word from picosoc_mem into read mux.

groups.name: CPU
groups.description: picorv32 core issuing native memory bus requests and receiving IRQs.

groups.name: Address decode and read mux
groups.description: Decodes mem_addr into slave selects, ORs readies and muxes read data.

groups.name: External iomem port
groups.description: Forwards high-address bus transactions to external memory-mapped IO.

groups.name: SPI flash controller
groups.description: spimemio executes-in-place flash reads and holds a config register.

groups.name: UART
groups.description: simpleuart with divider and data registers on the bus.

groups.name: On-chip RAM
groups.description: picosoc_mem SRAM with registered one-cycle ready.
